title: V11 Controlled Failure Injection Catalog
rule: Every fault must declare expected evidence, first divergence, remediation, and rollback.

cases.title: DHCP Offer Missing
cases.symptom: Client broadcasts Discover but Offer never appears
cases.rollback: Restore prior relay or VLAN policy

cases.title: DNS SERVFAIL
cases.symptom: Names fail while IP reachability remains

cases.title: OSPF MTU Mismatch
cases.remediation: Align effective MTU or document exception

cases.title: Trunk VLAN Omission
cases.symptom: Some VLANs fail across an uplink

cases.title: TCP MSS/MTU Black Hole
cases.symptom: Handshake works but large transfers stall

cases.title: Firewall Rule Shadowing
cases.remediation: Narrow or reorder rule after review

cases.title: NAT Conntrack Asymmetry
cases.symptom: Outbound creates but reply never returns
cases.remediation: Check srcnat, state and asymmetric routing

cases.title: STP Root Change
cases.remediation: Validate root priority and edge controls
